name: mission-control
description: One dashboard for every Claude session on your machine: what each is doing, cost, blockers, with pause and priorities.

alertMinutes.title: Alert after (minutes)
alertMinutes.description: Minutes a session may wait on a permission prompt or a question before you are alerted (through mods-hub when installed).

shareSession.title: Show this session
shareSession.description: Write this session's heartbeat so every cockpit lists it, and accept Pause / Stop / Note / Priority from them.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show when this session is paused, or when other sessions wait for you.
